name: web-to-mobile
description: Plan-first workflow for transforming websites and web apps into Expo React Native mobile apps.

interface.shortDescription: Turn web apps into mobile apps with an audit, plan, checklist, implementation, and tests
interface.longDescription: Use WebToMobile to inspect an existing website or web app, create a Markdown migration plan, map web routes to mobile navigation, implement an Expo React Native app from an approved checklist, and verify the result.
defaultPrompt: Use WebToMobile on the current workspace.
